exec_help:
Usage: codex exec [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]
Arguments: [PROMPT]
If stdin is piped and a prompt is also provided, stdin is appended as a <stdin> block
Options: --sandbox <SANDBOX_MODE> [read-only]
--cd <DIR>
--model <MODEL>
--ephemeral
-c, --config <key=value>
--color <COLOR>
--output-schema <FILE>
--output-last-message <FILE>
